description: This file contains unit tests for the OpenClaw project, specifically testing the executable skill bin trust and auto-allow functionality. It defines a struct 'ExecSkillBinTrustTests' with multiple test functions that verify trust index resolution, confidence in trusted skill bins, and rejection of untrusted paths. Helper functions for creating test executables and reports are included.

classes.name: ExecSkillBinTrustTests
classes.description: A struct encapsulating multiple unit tests for verifying trust management and auto-allow behaviors in the skill bin trusting system.

methods.name: build trust index resolves skill bin paths
methods.description: Test verifying that the trust index correctly resolves skill bin paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow accepts trusted resolved skill bin path
methods.description: Test confirming that the auto-allow mechanism approves trusted skill bin paths.

methods.name: skill auto allow rejects same basename at different path
methods.description: Test ensuring that untrusted skill bin paths with the same basename are rejected.

methods.name: makeExecutable
methods.description: Helper function creating an executable file with specified name in a temporary directory.

methods.name: makeReport
methods.description: Helper function creating a simulated skills status report with specified skill bins.
